scope.goal: Track framework workflow readiness for productization.

cases.notes: npm and pnpm install, dev server, browser preview, source edit, HMR state preservation, build, dist smoke, and restart pass in the reference harness.
npm and pnpm install, dev server, browser preview, React render, source edit, HMR state preservation, build, dist smoke, and restart pass in the reference harness.

gate.reason: The Vite React reference workflow passes for npm and pnpm, but the product browser guest runtime workflow has not yet run install -> dev -> preview -> edit/HMR -> build -> reload recovery.
requiredToPass: Run Vite React npm workflow through browser-guest-node-runtime
